items.translation: 通过getContext()方法提供所给存储库方法的元数据。

items.source: This class provides a series of static methods that interact with a thread-local storage of RepositoryMethodContext. The purpose of the class is to provide a convenient way to be used for an application.
items.translation: 该类提供了一系列静态方法，用于与线程本地存储中的RepositoryMethodContext进行交互。该类的目的是为应用程序提供一种便捷的使用方式。

items.source: Note that the caller should be careful to keep the old value as appropriate.
items.translation: 请注意，调用者应谨慎保留旧值。

items.source: Try to return the current repository method metadata.
items.translation: 尝试返回当前存储库的方法元数据。

items.source:
Try to return the current repository method metadata. This method is usable only if the calling method has been
invoked via a repository method, and the repository factory has been set to expose metadata. Otherwise, this method
will throw an IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 尝试返回当前存储库方法的元数据。仅当调用方法是通过存储库方法调用的，且存储库工厂已设置为公开元数据时，此方法才可用；否则，此方法将抛出 IllegalStateException 异常。

items.source: context - the metadata to expose (or null to reset it)
items.translation: context - 要暴露的元数据（或设为 null 以重置它）

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the repository method metadata cannot be found, because the method was invoked outside a repository method invocation context, or because the repository has not been configured to expose its metadata.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果找不到存储库方法的元数据，则抛出此异常。这可能是因为该方法在存储库方法调用上下文之外被调用，或者因为尚未配置存储库以公开其元数据。

items.source: the old metadata, which may be null if none was bound
items.translation: 旧的元数据，如果未绑定任何内容，则可能为null。

items.source: the current repository method metadata (never returns null)
items.translation: 当前存储库方法元数据（永远不会返回 null）
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，马克·帕卢赫

items.source: Associates a given RepositoryMethodContext with the current execution thread.
items.translation: 将给定的RepositoryMethodContext与当前执行线程关联。
